---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever you build or change any page of the Qissa Khwani Kahwa House website.
---

1. The brand name is "Qissa Khwani Kahwa House" and the tagline is "Kahwa, chapli kebab and good stories in old Peshawar." Write in a warm, short, welcoming tone, like a host greeting a guest.
2. Use only these colours: background #FBF5EC (cream), main #1F5F4A (kahwa green), accent #C8963E (brass), text #2B2118 (dark brown).
3. Use the Google Fonts "Playfair Display" for headings and "Poppins" for all other text.
4. Every page has the same header (brand name, tagline, and links to Home and About) and the same footer (Qissa Khwani Bazaar, Peshawar; Open daily 4 pm to 1 am; a copyright line with the current year).
5. Write prices as "Rs 250": Rs, a space, a whole number. Never use PKR, decimals or "/-".
6. Write phone numbers as 0300-1234567. Every form checks that the phone number has exactly 11 digits and shows a friendly error if not.
7. Write times in 12-hour format with lower-case am/pm, for example 4 pm, never 16:00.
8. Every menu item shows a name, a one-line description and a price, grouped under clear category headings.
9. Buttons are kahwa green with cream text and 8px rounded corners; cards have a thin brass border.
10. Every page works on a phone: one column below 700px wide and no sideways scrolling.
11. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only. The home page is always index.html in the main folder.
12. Never use photos or external images; use emoji or CSS shapes instead.
